verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no official SDK or client library for any language. Buzz offers other build surfaces: an official CLI, an MCP server, the buzz-acp harness, a persona-pack spec, and an open NIP-29/NIP-42 Nostr wire protocol. NOSTR.md says integration parity comes 'from the protocol itself rather than a separate bot API,' which means building against generic Nostr tooling, not a vendor SDK. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Because SDKs are a fair axis for a platform like this and none is evidenced, the verdict is none rather than na.
